<documents>
<document id="disputes-how-to-file">
HowˆtoˆfileˆaˆdisputeˆMostˆdisputesˆcanˆbeˆfiledˆyourselfˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfileˆoneˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆFileˆitˆyourselfˆ1.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed.ˆ2.ˆTapˆGetˆhelpˆandˆchooseˆtheˆreason.ˆ3.ˆAnswerˆtheˆquestionsˆandˆaddˆanyˆdocuments.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆfileˆ-ˆTheˆtransactionˆmustˆhaveˆposted.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ-ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactions:ˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆdate,ˆandˆtheˆcardˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆfirst.ˆ-ˆMerchantˆproblems:ˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate,ˆafterˆcontactingˆtheˆmerchant.ˆ##ˆFilingˆthroughˆsupportˆSupportˆcanˆopenˆdisputesˆtotalingˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆperˆcase.ˆLargerˆcasesˆgoˆtoˆourˆDisputesˆteam,ˆwhoˆwillˆcontactˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆOneˆdisputeˆperˆtransactionˆIfˆaˆtransactionˆalreadyˆhasˆanˆopenˆdispute,ˆaddˆinformationˆtoˆthatˆcaseˆinsteadˆofˆopeningˆaˆnewˆone.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-fraud-lock">
WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?ˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆ"LockedˆbyˆTallowbrook",ˆourˆfraudˆsystemsˆhaveˆplacedˆaˆfraudˆlockˆonˆit.ˆThisˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆaˆfreezeˆyouˆsetˆyourself.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆWeˆlockˆaˆcardˆwhenˆweˆseeˆactivityˆthatˆlooksˆlikeˆfraud,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆfraudˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆgetˆitˆremovedˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆanˆopenˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆanswerˆit.ˆTappingˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆusuallyˆremovesˆtheˆlockˆstraightˆaway.ˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆnoˆalert,ˆmessageˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆtheˆFraudˆteam.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆandˆneitherˆcanˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆoftenˆmuchˆsooner.ˆ##ˆMeanwhileˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆstillˆarriveˆwhileˆyourˆcardˆisˆlocked.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆstillˆuseˆBrookPayˆandˆtransfers,ˆunlessˆtheˆFraudˆteamˆhasˆrestrictedˆthoseˆtoo.ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆfraudˆalertˆbyˆgivingˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcode.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="account-under-review">
AccountˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆSometimesˆweˆneedˆtoˆreviewˆanˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆtoˆconfirmˆidentityˆdetails,ˆcheckˆunusualˆactivity,ˆorˆmeetˆlegalˆrequirements.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆcanˆdoˆduringˆaˆreviewˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆdeposits.ˆDependingˆonˆtheˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcash,ˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆorderˆaˆnewˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆseeˆAˆbannerˆinˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆtheˆaccountˆisˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestricted,ˆandˆwhatˆweˆneedˆfromˆyou,ˆifˆanything.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆItˆdependsˆonˆtheˆreason.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆdocuments,ˆsendingˆthemˆquicklyˆisˆtheˆbestˆwayˆtoˆspeedˆthingsˆup.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcan'tˆliftˆaˆreviewˆorˆrestriction,ˆandˆoftenˆcan'tˆshareˆtheˆreason.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆmessageˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆrestrictionsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆbecauseˆofˆaˆnegativeˆbalance,ˆaddingˆmoneyˆliftsˆtheˆrestrictionˆonceˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
